_comment: GPoreU settings example. Copy, edit, and pass with:  gporeu ... -c my_settings.json  (_-prefixed keys are ignored). Every field is optional; omitted fields take these defaults. Command-line flags override this file.
_methods: selectable set: gporeu --list-methods. Dependencies are added automatically (e.g. energy_histogram pulls in the CH4 energy grid and the grids). Aliases: psd, sa, network, energy, ehist.
_probes: optional probe overrides in sigma[A]/epsilon[K], e.g. {"helium_sigma": 2.58, "helium_epsilon": 10.22, "nitrogen_sigma": 3.314, "nitrogen_epsilon": 10.22, "ch4_sigma": 3.73, "ch4_epsilon": 148.0}

energy._comment: images=true performs exact periodic image enumeration at the cutoff; REQUIRED (min-image-only is wrong) whenever any cell width < 2*rcut.
